svg.title: Pattern nested inside a DIFFERENT pattern's tile (not a cycle)
svg.desc: Regression fixture: sceneBuilder.buildingPattern only catches a pattern tile that eventually references itself again (a cycle). A chain of otherwise-unrelated patterns -- patt1's tile fills with patt2, whose tile fills with patt3 -- is not a cycle and passes that guard every time, so nothing at scene-build time bounds it. Each level multiplies draw calls by its own cell count; pkg/svg/draw's per-call nesting-depth guard is what stops this from blowing up on a deeper chain. This 3-level chain is shallow enough to stay well under the depth cap and render normally.
